## Albabit LTX 2.3 Workflow for Radiance:

- Radiance: [Documentation](https://www.fxtdstudios.com/comfyu-radiance-docs/)
- Radiance: [GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance)
- Huggingface: [Lightricks/LTX-2.3](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/)
- Github: [LTX-2](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2)

## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

## Radiance Report Issues :
To report any issues with Radiance nodes, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/issues)
## Report LTX-2.3 Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

widgets_values: a beautiful young woman with auburn hair in a braided updo, all of her hair pinned up, light freckles across her nose, cheeks slightly reddened by the cold, blue-grey eyes, wearing a white knitted wool sweater, on a cold winter night, looking directly into the lens. Her skin shows fine pores and soft peach fuzz. She is riding a carousel at a night fair. Behind her, the fairground lamps are so far out of focus that they become huge, round bokeh discs in red, orange, yellow, pink and violet, filling the whole background. A few tiny snowflakes float in the air in front of her and sparkle in the colored light of the lamps. The scene tone is warm and dreamlike.

From the very first frame, the ride carries her and the camera steadily around together, so she stays still in the frame while the whole blurred background behind her keeps sliding past from the right edge of the frame to the left edge, without stopping until the end of the shot. She sways gently with the motion of the ride, and the cold air of the ride lifts a few loose strands of hair around her face. The soft creak of the turning carousel and distant fairground voices can be heard from the start, and they continue under her voice until the end of the shot. The colored light of the passing lamps washes over her face in colored waves, tinting it red. She begins to speak directly to the camera in a warm voice, her lips and jaw moving clearly with every word: 'Hey! Let's create some wonderful glowing scenes on LTX 2.3 with Radiance!' A puff of breath vapor leaves her mouth with each word and catches the colored light. After the last word, she closes her lips into a small, gentle smile and holds it, still looking into the lens, while the background keeps sliding past behind her from right to left.
ugly, low resolution, compression artifacts, robotic, robot, scratchy, garbled, bad audio

nodes.title: Note: Outputs
widgets_values:
**Outputs**:  
- The EXR sequence is the HDR master (scene-linear Rec.709, 1.0 = 203 nits);  
- The sound is saved beside it as a WAV, lined up with the frames' timecode.  
- The MP4 Writes are bypassed by default: select one and press Ctrl+B to enable it.  
Watch the PQ MP4 on an HDR display (mrv2, DaVinci Resolve); the SDR MP4 plays anywhere.

nodes.title: Note: Viewer
widgets_values:
**Viewer**:  
- A long 1080p shot does not fit in the Viewer's 2 GB cache, so the Viewer runs again on every queue. Bypass it when you don't need it.

nodes.title: Note: Detailer LoRA
widgets_values:
**Detailer LoRA** (optional):  
- Adds fine detail in the second pass. Red spots on the skin depend mostly on the "Distilled LoRA" strength used with it (Dev only): try a value between "0.5" and "0.85" (0.7 by default) before bypassing the Detailer. In Distilled mode, this LoRA is skipped: bypass the Detailer directly.

nodes.title: Note: Dev or Distilled
widgets_values:
**Dev or Distilled**:  
- Pick the model in the Loader's preset. Both Samplers, in "Auto", follow it.  
- "Match Text" finds "distilled" in its file name: the HighRes pass then skips the "Distilled LoRA".

nodes.title: Note: Keyframes
widgets_values:
**Keyframes** (optional: select the group, then Ctrl+B):  
- "Load Image": the frame the shot must reach.  
- "frame_idx": where it lands. -1 = last frame, 0 = first, others in multiples of 8.  
- "strength": how closely the video meets it (0.7 as in the official templates, 1.0 = exact).  
- With Image to Video it sets the end, with Text to Video the end alone.  
- "LTXVCropGuides", after the first pass, stays on: without keyframes it changes nothing.

nodes.title: Note: AI Fill
widgets_values:
**AI Fill** (optional: select the group, then Ctrl+B):
- Draws the inside of fully clipped highlights (sun, lamps, a white sky) that "SDR → HDR Universal" leaves flat, and sets their brightness (up to 3 stops above the master).
- Plausible, not recovered. The SDR view does not change: only the HDR master gains detail. With nothing clipped, it changes nothing.
- First run: downloads about 8 GB into models/radiance (RUDRA AI fill v3 and Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B). Needs about 16 GB of VRAM.
- "prompt_highlight": what to draw (e.g. "soft clouds in a bright blue sky"). Empty uses RUDRA's own prompt; a custom one loads an 11 GB text encoder once.
- Video: the frames go through in overlapping 33-frame windows, so a long shot takes a while.
